scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:wasm:apps && npm run build:wasm:core
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && node tools/build-chrome.mjs --profile=development && node tools/build-web.mjs
scripts.smoke:verify-kayros: npm run build:wasm && esbuild tools/smoke-verify-kayros.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=target/smoke-verify-kayros.mjs && node target/smoke-verify-kayros.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:wasm && npm run test:js && npm run test:rust
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:chrome && npm run verify:web
